title: Pay unstocked contraband's scarce price for every unit
message:
Pay unstocked contraband's scarce price for every unit

A port that does not stock a contraband good keeps no supply row for it,
yet cargosell priced a batch as if each unit sold raised that supply, so
selling a hold whole paid less than selling it a unit at a time. Every
unit now fetches the scarce price there, however the hold is split.

title: Seize contraband only where the port is known not to stock it
message:
Seize contraband only where the port is known not to stock it

port_stocks() answered no both for a missing stock row and for a failed
lookup, so a database error let customs confiscate contraband the port
itself stocks. It now counts the rows and reports a failed lookup apart;
customs let such a lot pass, while the market and the smugglers still
treat it as unstocked.

title: Settle a sinking's rewards in one transaction
message:
Settle a sinking's rewards in one transaction

A hull saved during her sinking countdown and restored before her wreck
was saved sank again and paid her renown, prize money and bounty a
second time; her owner's bounty was also cleared before any prize claim
committed. One transaction now records the bounty's collection, each
sharer's renown and prize claim, and the sunk hull's renown with her
last attacker consumed, so a restored hull goes down with no victor; if
it fails, nothing is paid. The settlement runs before the victor's crew
is trained, for the same reason. The claim queue now writes inside its
caller's transaction, and insurance keeps its own.

title: Leave hulls berthed in port out of a sinking's shares
message:
Leave hulls berthed in port out of a sinking's shares

Found by the economy gate: Kohdee's hull berthed at the East Dock, in
sight of the sinking, took a share of the renown and prize money.
Duris's sink_ship() passes over docked ships; so does the settlement
now. The gate's Kohdee leaves his group of one before the fight, so
only the hull that sinks the boat shares.

title: Add the live economy gate: contraband, customs, prize money, renown
message:
Add the live economy gate: contraband, customs, prize money, renown

test_vessel_economy_in_game.sh (tactical harness --economy) has Vesselmate
buy forbidden tomes at the harbor East Dock once an able crew signs on,
sell one under neutral colors, and lie a room off the dock; Kohdee's
warships sink Vesselmate's boat for prize money and 25 renown. The
harness then lifts the dock's stock of tomes and a second session sails
the smuggler in to meet customs.

title: Reward sinkings with prize money and renown; add contraband and customs
message:
Reward sinkings with prize money and renown; add contraband and customs

Study step S7 (docs/ongoing-projects/vessels-ships.md, Phase 7).

- Renown lives on the hull (ship_runtime_state.renown, Phase 23) and
  survives the wreck registry and trade-in. A player's hull that sinks
  another player's hull, with her grouped allies in sight, splits the
  sunk hull's weight in renown, and the loser drops it; shiprenown
  lists the ten most renowned hulls.
- Every sinking by a player's hull pays salvage, a bounty on the sunk
  hull's renown above 100 (raiders carry renown now), and the WANTED or
  HUNTED bounty of an owner who went down aboard, through the existing
  settlement queue with a mail receipt.
- Able and veteran hires and capital weapons need renown (a veteran
  gunner still serves a capital weapon); the crew casualty share of a
  player kill grows with the renown lost; the raider tier roll adds the
  quarry's renown.
- Ship Damage Control, an epic feat of five ranks, spares an owner's
  hull 4% plus 4% per rank of each blow.
- Contraband goods (trade_commodities.contraband_renown) are sold only
  where content stocks them, to a hull of their renown or with an able
  sailmaster and quartermaster; lawful ports' customs seize the units
  they do not stock; freight contracts carry lawful goods only.
- Cargo sales: SEADOG +10%, neutral colors -10%, warships -40%.
